market_summary: USD pairs and crypto remain heavily suppressed below daily VWAPs and Value Area Lows following strong New York impulse selling, but are currently showing exhaustion/consolidation near session lows without fresh RVOL breakout volume. Meanwhile, US100 has surged into major resistance at Call Wall #1 (28431) under a positive gamma dampening regime, limiting further upside room. All five symbols warrant a disciplined HOLD stance pending clearer structural triggers.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (3911.54) and far below POC (3978.13). CVD is BEARISH (-8.10) though showing minor short-term positive slope (+1.38). In NEW_YORK_SESSION, price is trading well below VWAP (3939.16) and EMA50 (3924.92). Signal bar touched the lower ATR band (3869.74) followed by a strong bounce in the forming candle towards Gamma Flip (3868.39). GEX regime is POSITIVE_DAMPENING with Call Wall #2 at 3916.83 and Put Wall #1 down at 3818.64. RVOL is normal (0.996) with no yellow spike on the bounce. With dampening dealer flows and price bouncing mid-range between Session Low and EMA20, immediate follow-through is uncertain. Prefer HOLD.

signals.rationale: Price is trading below VAL (1.32533) and below POC (1.32731). CVD is BEARISH (-8,768) despite short-term delta bounce (+5,568). signals.rationale: Price is above VAH (28231.55) and above POC (28122.95). CVD is NEUTRAL (+0.72) with modest positive slope (+0.25). In NEW_YORK_SESSION, trend is above VWAP (28153.97) and EMA50 (28182.92). The forming candle surged directly into Call Wall #1 (28431.46) and upper ATR band (28457.52). HOLD.
